comment: Anchor configuration for CV/Scripts/cover_letter.py, derived from the supplied cover-letter document template. paragraph_count is the number of paragraphs in the template's office:text. Each anchor lists the zero-based index of its first paragraph, how many paragraphs the section occupies, and the visible placeholder text found at that position. body_spacer_index is the zero-based index of the blank paragraph inserted between body paragraphs, or null when the template has no spacer. Regenerate this file whenever the template structure changes.

Salutation.text: Dear [Hiring Manager or name if known],
